description: For any supplied \(p\) representing \(g(e,a,x)\) on the nested pair code, the exact compiler \(F_p(e,a)=s(s(p,e),a)\) has an auxiliary index \(r\) such that the specified primitive-recursive \(h(a)=s(d(r),a)\), where \(d(r)=s(r,r)\), satisfies \(\varphi_{h(a)}(x)\simeq g(h(a),a,x)\) for all \(a,x\).
